correctness.rationale: Schur-orthogonality scaling was reconstructed from normalized counting measure. The conjugation decomposition of End([n-1,1]) was checked dimension by dimension for every \(n\ge4\). For a three-cycle, triangle-Laplacian diagonalization gives scalar norm (n-4)^2/(n-1), standard norm 3(n-3)/(n-2), second-row norm 3(n-4)(n-3)/(2(n-2)(n-1)), and alternating norm 3/2. Conjugacy averaging and dimensions give all four exact eigenvalues. Singular \(n=4\) and coincident \(n=5\) cases are explicitly retained. Finite exact Gram traces and minimal-polynomial annihilators were exactly computed for \(4\le n\le8\) using the embedded checker. Finite tests are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete standard Fourier block is a canonical nonabelian band, and restriction to a full three-cycle class is a canonical conjugacy-invariant spatial sampling problem. The exact four-sector formula identifies the sharp recoverability threshold \(n=5\) and all-dimension condition number, unlike a routine scalar/character-counting identity. The orientation-sensitive exterior sector is essential and makes the result structurally different from transposition sampling. The theorem supplies interpretable exact rank and stability for all \(n\ge4\) without claiming a broader paper-sized result.
